name: final-pin

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: decode x4 and cold 32K/128K/224K replies pinned or reproduced (7; 0 reproduced byte for byte, added ['decode/code', 'decode/json', 'decode/prose', 'decode/structured', 'prefill/128k', 'prefill/224k', 'prefill/32k'])
pin run: every concurrent (c=4, c=8) reply equal to its solo reply
boot g (fresh boot): decode x4, c=4/c=8/rolling and cold 32K/128K/224K replies equal the pinned replies: PASS pin x2 (decode run and prefill run)
boot g: vision replies equal bench/reference-vision.json

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh bench pin   (boot p: writes or reproduces bench/reference.json and bench/reference-vision.json)
./inkling2mini.sh bench all   (boot g, a fresh boot: every reply compared with the pinned references)
notes: Boot to boot: references written (or reproduced) by boot p of this run, then every pinned reply reproduced by boot g, a fresh boot of the same build and configuration. The references name the engine they were pinned on (meta.engine). bench/reference*.json are committed by the lead with this record.
